physics-m1-q5.goal: Apply principles to solve the inquiry problem.
physics-m1-q5.material: Ibhola yentsimbi enobunzima obuyi-10 N emoyeni intywiliselwe ngokupheleleyo emanzini kwaye ukufundwa kwesikali sentwasahlobo yi-8 N. Amandla okuntanta awafumanayo ibhola yentsimbi emanzini angakanani?

physics-killer-07.title: Kubukelwe ukusuka eMhlabeni, umgama
physics-killer-07.goal: Apply principles to solve the inquiry problem.
physics-killer-07.material: Kubukelwe ukusuka eMhlabeni, umgama ukuya kwinkwenkwezi ethile ngu-$6$ iminyaka yokukhanya. Inqanawa yasemajukujukwini ihamba ukusuka eMhlabeni ngokuya kule nkwenkwezi ngesantya esingatshintshiyo $0.6c$ kwaye ifike kwinkwenkwezi. Yeyiphi indibaniselwano echanekileyo ebonisa ixesha lokubhabha elilinganiswe ngumbukeli wasemhlabeni kunye nexesha lokubhabha elilinganiswe ngewotshi engaphakathi enqanaweni ngokulandelelana? (Isantya sokukhanya $c$ singu-$1$ iminyaka yokukhanya/ngonyaka.)
physics-killer-07.s.s1.prompt: Kubukelwe ukusuka eMhlabeni, umgama ukuya kwinkwenkwezi ethile ngu-$6$ iminyaka yokukhanya. Inqanawa yasemajukujukwini ihamba ukusuka eMhlabeni ngokuya kule nkwenkwezi ngesantya esingatshintshiyo $0.6c$ kwaye ifike kwinkwenkwezi. Yeyiphi indibaniselwano echanekileyo ebonisa ixesha lokubhabha elilinganiswe ngumbukeli wasemhlabeni kunye nexesha lokubhabha elilinganiswe ngewotshi engaphakathi enqanaweni ngokulandelelana? (Isantya sokukhanya $c$ singu-$1$ iminyaka yokukhanya/ngonyaka.)
physics-killer-07.s.s1.explain: Umbukeli wasemhlabeni: $\Delta t=\dfrac{6\text{ iminyaka yokukhanya}}{0.6c}=10$ iminyaka. $\gamma=1/\sqrt{1-0.6^2}=1/0.8=1.25$. Iwotshi yenqanawa ilinganisa ukuqala nokufika kwindawo enye, ngoko lixesha elililo kwaye $\Delta t_0=\Delta t/\gamma=10/1.25=8$ iminyaka. Ukuba uphinda-phinda, $12.5$ iminyaka (impendulo engalunganga ③), ukuba uhlula nge-$\gamma^2$, $6.4$ iminyaka (impendulo engalunganga ①), ukuba amaxabiso amabini ayatshintshwa, ngumphendulo ongalunganga ④. (Ngokwembono yenqanawa umgama uncipha ube $6/1.25=4.8$ iminyaka yokukhanya kwaye uhambelana ne-$4.8/0.6=8$ iminyaka.)
